summary: Nordic country on the west of the Scandinavian peninsula, with Oslo as its capital. It adopted its constitution in 1814 and became fully independent from Sweden in 1905. It is a constitutional monarchy.

events.note: Dated from the traditional year 872, when Harald Fairhair is said to have united Norway at the battle of Hafrsfjord. Historians place the battle a little later. Norway was under Danish and then Swedish kings from 1380 to 1905.

events.label: Constitution
events.note: The constitution was signed at Eidsvoll.

events.label: Independence
events.note: The union with Sweden was dissolved.
